parsed.why: Enforced sodomy statute plus documented police targeting of trans women: arbitrary detention, torture-level forced exams, bribery, coerced informing. No recourse, no registration, official hostility. Thin visitor-specific data but state-directed, severe, recurring.

Hostile federal document/border regime with documented detentions of foreigners and allied advisories; birth-sex facility bans in many states; custody abuse. Offset by no criminalisation, gender-identity hate-crime law, courts and protective states operating.

Unenforced sodomy law plus a public 'impersonation' offence aimed at presentation; no protections or recourse; rising fundamentalism; one activist murdered. Positive traditional third-gender culture, but enforcement practice undocumented.

Decriminalised 2016 and 2024 law adding gender identity to hate-crime enhancements; no documented targeting, border friction, facility bans or violence. Thin enforcement data and no documented social acceptance keep it below the acceptance-with-protections tier.

Comprehensive constitutional and statutory gender-identity protections, but documented enforcement failure (no sentences for anti-LGBT murders) and a 2024 survey showing widespread LGBTI exclusion; public support dated. No criminalisation, no documented police targeting.
